query:
-- Verificar vendas ativas do Iago
SELECT id, clienteNome, valorColetado, valorFaturado, custoServico, servicos, cancelada
FROM vendas WHERE clienteNome LIKE '%Iago%';

-- Verificar leads do Iago no pipeline
SELECT l.id, l.nome, c.nome as coluna FROM leads l
LEFT JOIN colunas_pipeline c ON l.colunaId = c.id
WHERE l.nome LIKE '%Iago Soares%';
